holder-quote: Ser Gorethem hesitated one last time. But the Dragon just looked at him, and the trembling blade steadied.
effect-quote: The banquet hall quaked. Rabbiteater felt an explosion of mist and rain strike him like a slap to his face.

holder-quote: Gorethem Krakenblood, the Lance of Kaazaldrin, finally stopped
effect-quote: the shockwave blew Anand off his feet and sent him spinning as the Waterproof rocked
